items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Nestico's arrangements sound like, to me, they have -- like a school, like the college kids' arrangements.

ctx.x: I mean, he gets these arrangements by this guy (Sam) Nestico and they're like imitations of Hefti's.

Yeah. Well, Nestico, his arrangements don't -- Neal is the better of the two, you know. Nestico's arrangements sound like, to me, they have -- like a school, like the college kids' arrangements. You know? Basie likes that, but his arrangements really don't knock me out in Basie's band. I'd much rather have a Neal Hefti, even an old Neal Hefti arrangement, than a new Nestico arrangement.
Well, I think that, you know, after that *"Flight of the Foo Birds."
